mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, content, image_url, post_id, msg_type) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{postId}, #{msgType})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, content, image_url, post_id, msg_type, is_read, send_time FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY send_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0
